title: Local Alert Severity Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=local:alert severity_score=*
| stats sum(severity_score) as total_value, avg(severity_score) as avg_value by alert_source
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks alert source values by total and average severity score across local alert events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `severity_score` values for each local alert event and review total and average severity score by alert source.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total severity score.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which alert source shows the biggest severity score numbers in your local alert data.
